origin_note: Ranges are calibrated on forecasts made at the close of WASDE release days.

fx_default.source: Banco Central do Brasil, PTAX selling rate (SGS 1)

intervals.range_rule: Pre-registered 2026-11-08: baseline, one EWMA(0.94) FHS challenger and a naive lognormal vol band, chosen on validation only by the same interval-score ratio; only the winner is published, the holdout is reported.
intervals.rule: Chosen on validation only: mean 80% + 95% interval score relative to the baseline, averaged over models and horizons; the holdout is reported.

inference_rule.adjustment: Holm across all 9 Clark-West tests (3 challengers x 3 horizons)
inference_rule.champion: Replace no change only if Holm-adjusted CW p < champion_alpha and the validation primary loss is lower than the random walk's
inference_rule.direction_test: Pesaran-Timmermann, regression form, HAC (Bartlett, lag h-1)
inference_rule.calibration: HAC SE (Bartlett, lag h-1); moving-block bootstrap 95% CI (block h, 2000 draws); n_eff = n p(1-p) / long-run variance; Kupiec and Christoffersen on the h non-overlapping subsamples (median p); MDE at 5% one-sided, 80% power, MAE units
inference_rule.v1: DM on absolute USD/t errors, CW on squared log-return errors, Holm across the three horizons of each model, champion tie-break on MAE, iid binomial direction test
